description: The artisan command has parser coverage only. There are no tests for submission, the destructive-confirmation retry, --no-wait plus --run polling, the wait loop's timeout, --json output shape, or exit-code propagation from the run's exit_code. Add mocked-HTTP contract tests in packages/dply-cli/test covering each path. Without these the command's behaviour is unprotected against the response-shape change T-007 will make.
title: CLI contract tests for dply site artisan
